prompt:
Use $mother-in-law at .agents/skills/mother-in-law/SKILL.md.

QA this search flow. Reproduce any realistic interaction failure with a deterministic local test. Do not modify production code.

Required verification and delivery: Test both normal and reversed completion order with controlled overlapping requests against actual Search. Capture actual assertions and controls, not just a nonzero exit. Bound behavior-dependent waits and clean up owned tasks. Keep a rerunnable local test; preserve production files.
Keep all discovery and work within this project. Do not install dependencies, use external services or other skills, or delegate. Preserve user changes. No publishing or deployment.
For normal overlapping completion, require the latest result after both requests finish. While the newer request is pending, no particular intermediate display is required: retaining the previously displayed result is allowed. Do not make an older response appearing during that interval a required behavior. The reversed-completion test must still detect an older response overwriting the completed latest result.

Work only inside this synthetic project. Do not use external services or other installed skills. Do not delegate.
personal_skill_disable_verification: not checked; inspect recorded initial context separately

capture_diagnostics.limitation: Empty command output may be legitimate. Nonempty output may still be incomplete. Item errors may be recoverable; review actual execution. These diagnostics neither prove full tool-output capture nor score task success.

pre_collection_index.artifact_scope: Local raw artifact; binary index is not included by exporter

pre_model_index.artifact_scope: Local raw artifact; binary index is not included by exporter

pre_model_project_files.limitation: Local regular-file bytes/modes and symlink targets before model execution; not directory metadata, an atomic snapshot, transient-change evidence, or an automatic preservation verdict. Raw inventory is not exported.

index_comparison.limitation: Before-model versus before-collector byte/mode identity only; not semantic index equality, all Git metadata, or transient-change evidence. Index refresh may change bytes without changing staged content.
